muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿ذلك الذي يبشر الله عباده الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات﴾: «ذلك»: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); «الذي»: its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿يبشر الله عباده﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position, and the returning pronoun is omitted, i.e. «يبشر به عباده» (with which He gives glad tidings to His servants); ﴿الذين آمنوا﴾: a naʿt (adjective); ﴿عملوا الصالحات﴾: conjoined to «آمنوا».
﴿قل لا أسألكم عليه أجرا إلا المودة في القربى﴾: «قل»: an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); «لا»: negative; «أسألكم»: an imperfect verb, with a latent fāʿil, its implied form being "I" (أنا), and a first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «عليه»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); «أجرًا»: a second mafʿūl bihi; «إلا»: for exception; «المودة»: excepted (mustathnā), or a badal (substitute) of ﴿أجرا﴾. «في القربى»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of «المودة», i.e. «ثابتة في القربى» (established in kinship).
﴿ومن يقترف حسنة نزد له فيها حسنا إن الله غفور شكور﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «مَن»: a conditional noun that makes jussive, mubtadaʾ; «يقترف»: an imperfect verb, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو); «حسنة»: mafʿūl bihi, i.e. «ومن يكتسب حسنة» (whoever earns a good deed); «نزد»: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «له»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نزد﴾; «فيها»: a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to ﴿نزد﴾; «حسنًا»: mafʿūl bihi; «إن»: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); «الله»: the noun of «إن»; «غفور شكور»: two khabars of «إن»; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿أم يقولون افترى على الله كذبا﴾: «أم» is a disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) conjunction, so it has the sense of «بل» (rather) plus the hamza of interrogation, the implied form being «بل أيقولون افترى؟» (rather, do they say he has invented?), and the hamza is for disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī); or ﴿أم﴾ is connected (muttaṣila), in which case a clause must be implied so that the balance [between the two alternatives] is sound, the implied form being «أيقرون به أم يقولون افترى» (do they acknowledge it, or do they say he has invented?). ﴿يقولون﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and a fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿افترى﴾ is the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech); ﴿على الله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿افترى﴾; ﴿كذبا﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb «افترى», i.e. he fabricated a lie and contrived it; or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. he invented for the sake of lying; or a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. he invented while lying, and it is an emphatic ḥāl.
﴿فإن يشأ الله يختم على قلبك﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive or a conjunction; «إن»: conditional; «يشأ»: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «الله»: fāʿil; «يختم»: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ﴿على قلبك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يختم﴾; the clause ﴿فإن يشأ الله...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿ويمح الله الباطل ويحق الحق بكلماته﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; ﴿يمحو الله الباطل﴾: an imperfect verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; ﴿يحق الحق﴾: conjoined to «يمحو الله الباطل»; ﴿بكلماته﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يحق﴾.
﴿إنه عليم بذات الصدور﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the hāʾ is its noun, and «وعليم» is its khabar (predicate); ﴿بذات الصدور﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿عليم﴾.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿وهو الذي يقبل التوبة عن عباده﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; «هو»: mubtadaʾ (subject); «الذي»: khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿يقبل التوبة﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿عن عباده﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿التوبة﴾. ﴿عن﴾ here either has the sense of «من» (from), or [it is that] the verb «قبل» (to accept) passes to a second object by means of «من» and «عن» because it includes the sense of taking and of removing: because it includes the sense of taking it passes [to its object] with «من» — one says «قبلته منه», i.e. I took it from him — and because it includes the sense of removal and separation it passes with «عن» — one says «قبلته عنه», i.e. I removed it from him.
﴿ويعفو عن السيئات ويعلم ما تفعلون﴾: two clauses conjoined to what preceded.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿ويستجيب الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات ويزيدهم من فضله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «يستجيب»: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form referring back to Allah the Exalted; «الذين»: a relative noun, accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. «ويستجيب الله للذين آمنوا» (and Allah responds to those who believe); or the relative noun is the fāʿil, or a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿عملوا الصالحات﴾: conjoined to ﴿آمنوا﴾, falling within the scope of the ṣila. ﴿يزيدهم﴾: also conjoined; ﴿من فضله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يزيدهم﴾.
﴿والكافرون لهم عذاب شديد﴾: «الكافرون»: mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); «عذاب»: a postponed mubtadaʾ; «شديد»: a naʿt (adjective); the clause ﴿لهم عذاب شديد﴾ is the khabar of «الكافرون».

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿ولو بسط الله الرزق لعباده﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; «لو»: conditional; the clause ﴿بسط الله الرزق﴾ is a verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿لعباده﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿بسط﴾; and the lām occurs in the answer of «لو».
﴿لبغوا في الأرض﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «بغوا»: a past verb and its fāʿil; ﴿في الأرض﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿بغوا﴾; the clause ﴿بغوا في الأرض﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a condition that does not make jussive.
﴿ولكن ينزل بقدر ما يشاء﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «لكن»: a particle of rectification (istidrāk); «ينزل»: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); «بقدر»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); «ما»: mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿يشاء﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿إنه بعباده خبير بصير﴾: «إن»: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the hāʾ: the noun of «إن»; ﴿بعباده﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خبير﴾; «خبير بصير»: two khabars (predicates) of «إن».

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿وهو الذي ينزل الغيث من بعد ما قنطوا وينشر رحمته﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «هو»: mubtadaʾ (subject); «الذي»: its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿ينزل الغيث﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿من بعد﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); «ما»: maṣdariyya, and together with what it governs it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive by being annexed to the adverb, i.e. «من بعد قنوطهم» (after their despair); ﴿ينشر رحمته﴾: conjoined to «ينزل الغيث».
﴿وهو الولي الحميد﴾: «هو»: mubtadaʾ; «الولي الحميد»: its two khabars.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿ومن آياته خلق السماوات والأرض وما بث فيهما من دابة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿من آياته﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); «خلق»: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); «السماوات»: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «الأرض»: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «السماوات», genitive (majrūr); «ما»: a relative noun in the position of a nominative, conjoined to «خلق», or in the position of a genitive, conjoined to «السماوات»; the clause ﴿بث﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position, and the returning pronoun is omitted, i.e. «وما بثه» (and what He spread). ﴿فيهما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿بث﴾; ﴿من دابة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted [word], a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the omitted returning pronoun, or a tamyīz (specification) of ﴿ما﴾.
﴿وهو على جمعهم إذا يشاء قدير﴾: «هو»: mubtadaʾ; ﴿على جمعهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قدير﴾; «إذا»: an adverb of future time, attached to ﴿جمعهم﴾; the clause ﴿يشاء﴾ is in the position of a genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; «قدير»: the khabar of «هو».

muyesser-irab:30-30.t: ﴿وما أصابكم من مصيبة فبما كسبت أيديكم ويعفو عن كثير﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «ما»: conditional; «أصابكم»: a past verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and it is in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «من مصيبة»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the fāʾ is connective [of the apodosis]; «بما»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. «فذلك بما كسبت» (then that is because of what [your hands] earned); «ما»: relative, genitive by the bāʾ; the clause ﴿كسبت﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position; «أيديكم»: fāʿil. Or «ما» is relative, and the fāʾ enters upon the khabar because the relative noun is likened to the condition. The wāw is a conjunction; «يعفو»: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, referring back to Allah; «عن كثير»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يعفو﴾.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿وما أنتم بمعجزين في الأرض﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negative that operates like «ليس»; ﴿أنتم﴾ is the noun of «ما»; ﴿بمعجزين﴾: the bāʾ is a redundant (ṣila) preposition, and ﴿معجزين﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative (manṣūb) in position and genitive (majrūr) in form by the bāʾ; ﴿في الأرض﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وما لكم من دون الله من ولي ولا نصير﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «ما»: negative; ﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; ﴿من دون﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of «وليّ»; the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿من﴾ is a redundant (ṣila) preposition, and ﴿ولي﴾ is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) in position and genitive in form by ﴿مِن﴾; ﴿لا نصير﴾: conjoined to ﴿ولي﴾.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t: ﴿ومن آياته الجوار في البحر كالأعلام﴾: ﴿من آياته﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); «الجوار»: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the omitted yāʾ; ﴿في البحر﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿كالأعلام﴾: the kāf is a noun in the sense of «مثل» (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl, and ﴿الأعلام﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿إن يشأ يسكن الريح فيظللن رواكد على ظهره﴾: «إن»: conditional; «يشأ»: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil (agent) is optionally latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو), referring back to Allah the Exalted; «يسكن»: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); it is a verb, and the fāʿil is latent, referring back to Allah the Exalted; «الريح»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʾ is a conjunction; «يظللن»: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural, in the position of a jussive (majzūm), conjoined to «يسكن الريح»; it is with fatḥa on the lām, because the past is with kasra on it; the nūn of the feminine plural is the noun of «يظللن», because it is an incomplete verb; «رواكد»: its khabar (predicate); ﴿على ظهره﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿رواكد﴾.
﴿إن في ذلك لآيات لكل صبار شكور﴾: «إن»: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ﴿في ذلك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar of «إن»; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); «آيات»: the noun of «إن»; ﴿لكل﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «آيات»; «صبار»: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «شكور»: a naʿt of «صبار».

muyesser-irab:34-34.t: ﴿أو يوبقهن بما كسبوا ويعف عن كثير﴾: «أو»: a conjunction; «يوبقهن»: conjoined to «يسكن»; ﴿بما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يوبقهن﴾; ﴿ما﴾: relative or maṣdariyya, and the bāʾ is causal, i.e. because of the sins they earned; «يعف»: also conjoined to «يسكن»; ﴿عن كثير﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يعف﴾.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿ويعلم الذين يجادلون في آياتنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «يعلم»: an imperfect verb conjoined to an implied causal [clause], i.e. «يفرقهم لينتقم منهم ويعلم الذين يجادلون» (He separates them so as to take vengeance on them, and so that those who dispute may know) [Translator's note: «يفرقهم» is probably a misprint for «يغرقهم» (He drowns them)], and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), referring back to Allah the Exalted; «الذين»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿يجادلون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿في آياتنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يجادلون﴾. [Translator's note: as printed, «يعلم» is given a latent fāʿil referring to Allah with «الذين» as its object; yet the next line makes the clause «ما لهم من محيص» stand in place of the two objects of «يعلم», which fits «الذين» being the fāʿil ("so that those who dispute may know"). The text is translated as written.]
﴿ما لهم من محيص﴾: «ما»: negative; ﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); «مِن»: a redundant (ṣila) preposition; «محيص»: genitive (majrūr) in form, nominative (marfūʿ) in position as a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the negative clause stands in place of the two objects of «يعلم», which is suspended from operation by the negation.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿فما أوتيتم من شيء فمتاع الحياة الدنيا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; «ما»: conditional, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), a fronted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿أوتيتم﴾; «أوتيتم»: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and a nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿من شيء﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿ما﴾; the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis; «متاع»: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. «فهو متاع الحياة الدنيا» (then it is the enjoyment of the life of this world); the clause ﴿فما أوتيتم...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وما عند الله خير وأبقى للذين آمنوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «ما»: a relative noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ; «عند»: an adverb attached to an omitted [verb that is the] ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. «الله»: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «خير»: the khabar of ﴿ما﴾; «أبقى»: conjoined to ﴿خير﴾; ﴿للذين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أبقى﴾; «آمنوا»: a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun.
﴿وعلى ربهم يتوكلون﴾: ﴿على ربهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يتوكلون﴾; the clause ﴿يتوكلون﴾ is conjoined to ﴿آمنوا﴾, falling within the scope of the ṣila.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿والذين يجتنبون كبائر الإثم والفواحش﴾: «الذين»: conjoined to His words ﴿للذين﴾; the clause ﴿يجتنبون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position; «كبائر»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «الإثم»: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «الفواحش»: conjoined to «كبائر».
﴿وإذا ما غضبوا هم يغفرون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «إذا»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يغفرون﴾; «ما»: redundant (ṣila); the clause ﴿غضبوا﴾ is in the position of a genitive by the annexation of «إذا» to it. «هم»: mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يغفرون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of «هم»; the clause ﴿هم يغفرون﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a condition that does not make jussive. The clause ﴿وإذا ما غضبوا...﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿يجتنبون﴾, falling within the scope of the ṣila, and the conjunction is of the conjoining of a nominal [clause] to a verbal one.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t: ﴿والذين استجابوا لربهم وأقاموا الصلاة وأمرهم شورى بينهم ومما رزقناهم ينفقون﴾: conjoined to what preceded; the clause ﴿استجابوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿لربهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿استجابوا﴾; «أقاموا الصلاة»: a verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «أمرهم»: mubtadaʾ (subject); «شورى»: khabar (predicate); «بينهم»: an adverb attached to ﴿شورى﴾; ﴿مما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ينفقون﴾; the clause ﴿رزقناهم﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:39-39.t: ﴿والذين إذا أصابهم البغي هم ينتصرون﴾: conjoined to what preceded; «إذا»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ينتصرون﴾; «أصابهم البغي»: a verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a fāʿil (agent), and the clause is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «هم»: mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿ينتصرون﴾ is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ ﴿هم﴾; the clause ﴿هم ينتصرون﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t:
﴿وجزاء سيئة سيئة مثلها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «جزاء»: mubtadaʾ (subject); «سيئةٍ»: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «سيئةٌ»: khabar (predicate); «مثلها»: a naʿt (adjective) of «سيئة».
﴿فمن عفا وأصلح فأجره على الله إنه لا يحب الظالمين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «مَن»: a conditional noun that makes jussive, mubtadaʾ; «عفا»: a past verb in the position of a jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو); «أصلح»: conjoined to «عفا»; the fāʾ is connective; «أجره»: mubtadaʾ; ﴿على الله﴾: a preposition and a genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar; the nominal clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the protasis together with its apodosis is the khabar of ﴿مَن﴾; the clause ﴿إنه لا يحب الظالمين﴾ is a causal explanation (taʿlīl); «إن»: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the hāʾ: the noun of «إن»; the clause ﴿لا يحب الظالمين﴾ is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t: ﴿ولمن انتصر بعد ظلمه فأولئك ما عليهم من سبيل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ); «مَن»: a conditional noun that makes jussive, mubtadaʾ (subject); «انتصر»: a past verb in the position of a jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «بعد»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿انتصر﴾; «ظلمه»: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the annexation is of the type of annexing the maṣdar (verbal noun) to its object; the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis; «أولئك»: mubtadaʾ; «ما»: negative; ﴿عليهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); «من»: a redundant (ṣila) preposition; «سبيل»: genitive in form, nominative (marfūʿ) in position by inception (ibtidāʾ); the clause ﴿ما عليهم من سبيل﴾ is the khabar of the demonstrative; the clause ﴿فأولئك ما عليهم من سبيل﴾ is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the protasis together with its apodosis is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿مَن﴾.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t:
﴿إنما السبيل على الذين يظلمون الناس﴾: «إنما»: [«إن»] restrained [from operating] and the restraining [«ما»] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); «السبيل»: mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿على الذين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿يظلمون الناس﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿ويبغون في الأرض بغير الحق أولئك لهم عذاب أليم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «يبغون»: conjoined to «يظلمون»; ﴿في الأرض﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يبغون﴾; ﴿بغير﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿يبغون﴾; «أولئك»: mubtadaʾ; ﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; «عذاب»: a postponed mubtadaʾ; «أليم»: a naʿt (adjective); the clause ﴿لهم عذاب أليم﴾ is the khabar of «أولئك»; the clause ﴿أولئك لهم عذاب أليم﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).

muyesser-irab:43-43.t: ﴿ولمن صبر وغفر إن ذلك لمن عزم الأمور﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ); «مَن»: a conditional noun that makes jussive, mubtadaʾ (subject); «صبر»: a past verb in the position of a jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «وغفر»: the wāw is a conjunction, and «غفر» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. In the statement there is an omission of the fāʾ from His words ﴿إن ذلك﴾, which is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); so it is preferable to make ﴿مَن﴾ a relative noun, mubtadaʾ, and His words ﴿إن ذلك﴾ the khabar (predicate). «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «ذلك» is its noun, the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿من عزم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar of «إن»; «الأمور»: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿ومن يضلل الله فما له من ولي من بعده﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «مَن»: conditional, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «يضلل»: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «الله»: its fāʿil (agent); the fāʾ is connective; «ما»: negative; ﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); «مِن»: a redundant (ṣila) preposition; «ولي»: genitive (majrūr) in form, nominative (marfūʿ) in position, a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿من بعده﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ولي﴾.
﴿وترى الظالمين لما رأوا العذاب يقولون هل إلى مرد من سبيل﴾: «ترى»: an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت), and the seeing is visual; «الظالمين»: mafʿūl bihi; «لما»: temporal (ḥīniyya), or connective; «رأوا العذاب»: a past verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿يقولون﴾ is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «هل»: an interrogative particle; «إلى مرد»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; «من»: a redundant preposition; «سبيل»: genitive in form, nominative in position as a postponed mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t:
﴿وتراهم يعرضون عليها خاشعين من الذل ينظرون من طرف خفي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «تراهم»: conjoined to ﴿ترى﴾; the clause ﴿يعرضون﴾ is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), because the seeing is visual; the wāw in ﴿يعرضون﴾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); «عليها»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يعرضون﴾, and the pronoun in ﴿عليها﴾ refers back to the Fire; «خاشعين»: a second ḥāl (circumstantial); «من الذل»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خاشعين﴾, i.e. because of it, and it may be attached to ﴿ينظرون﴾; «من طرف»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ينظرون﴾; «خفي»: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿طرف﴾.
﴿وقال الذين آمنوا إن الخاسرين الذين خسروا أنفسهم وأهليهم يوم القيامة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «قال الذين»: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «آمنوا»: a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿الذين﴾, with no grammatical position. «إن»: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); «الخاسرين»: the noun of «إن»; «الذين»: the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; «خسروا أنفسهم»: a verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿خسروا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. «أهليهم»: conjoined to «أنفسهم»; «يوم»: an adverb attached to ﴿خسروا﴾, or to ﴿قال﴾, i.e. they will say on the Day of Resurrection, when they see them in that state; «القيامة»: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ألا إن الظالمين في عذاب مقيم﴾: «ألا»: a particle of alerting (tanbīh); «إن»: an abrogating particle; «الظالمين»: the noun of «إن»; «في عذاب»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of «إن»; «مقيم»: a naʿt; the clause is part of what Allah the Exalted says, and it may also be part of their speech.

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿وما كان لهم من أولياء ينصرونهم من دون الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «ما»: negative; «كان»: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; «لهم»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of «كان»; «من»: a redundant (ṣila) preposition; «أولياء»: genitive (majrūr) by «من» in form, in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as the postponed noun of «كان»; the clause ﴿ينصرونهم﴾ is a ṣifa (adjective) of «أولياء»; «من دون»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿ينصرونهم﴾; «الله»: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ومن يضلل الله فما له من سبيل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «مَن»: conditional, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), a fronted object of ﴿يضلل﴾; «يضلل»: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «الله»: fāʿil; the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «ما»: negative; «له»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; «من»: a redundant preposition; «سبيل»: genitive by «من» in form, in the position of a nominative as a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿استجيبوا لربكم من قبل أن يأتي يوم لا مرد له من الله﴾: «استجيبوا»: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); «لربكم»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿استجيبوا﴾, i.e. answer Him with tawḥīd and worship; «من قبل»: a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to ﴿استجيبوا﴾; «أن» and what falls within its scope are a maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; «يوم»: fāʿil; «لا»: the lā of generic negation; «مرد»: its noun, indeclinable on fatḥa; «له»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); «من الله»: a preposition and a genitive noun, attached to ﴿مرد﴾, because it is a mīmī maṣdar; the clause ﴿لا مرد له من الله﴾ is a ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿يوم﴾; or ﴿من الله﴾ is attached to ﴿يأتي﴾, i.e. before there comes from Allah a day which no one will be able to turn back.
﴿ما لكم من ملجأ يومئذ وما لكم من نكير﴾: «ما»: negative; «لكم»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; «من»: a redundant (ṣila) preposition; «ملجأ»: genitive (majrūr) in form, nominative (marfūʿ) in position as a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿يومئذ﴾: «يوم» is an adverb of time attached to ﴿ملجأ﴾ if it is a mīmī maṣdar, or attached to the khabar of ﴿ملجأ﴾ to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached if ﴿ملجأ﴾ is a noun of place; «إذٍ»: a noun, indeclinable on a sukūn implied (muqaddar) because the place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the tanwīn compensates for a clause, the implied form being «يوم إذ يأتي ذلك اليوم» (on the day when that day comes); ﴿ما لكم من نكير﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ما لكم من ملجأ﴾.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t:
﴿فإن أعرضوا فما أرسلناك عليهم حفيظا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; «إن»: conditional; «أعرضوا»: a past verb in the position of a jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the fāʾ is connective; «ما»: negative; «أرسلناك»: a verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «عليهم»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حفيظًا﴾; «حفيظًا»: ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause ﴿فإن أعرضوا...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿إن عليك إلا البلاغ﴾: «إن»: negative; «عليك»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); «إلا»: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); «البلاغ»: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿وإنا إذا أذقنا الإنسان منا رحمة فرح بها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «وإن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; «إذا»: an adverb of future time containing the sense of condition; the clause ﴿أذقنا﴾ is in the position of a genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; «الإنسان»: mafʿūl bihi; «منا»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, because it was originally a ṣifa (adjective) of «رحمة» and was put before it; «رحمة»: a second mafʿūl bihi, i.e. a blessing; the clause ﴿فرح بها﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a condition that does not make jussive, and the clause of condition and apodosis is the khabar of «إن».
﴿وإن تصبهم سيئة بما قدمت أيديهم فإن الإنسان كفور﴾: conjoined to what preceded; «إن»: conditional; «تصبهم»: the protasis; the pronoun refers back to «الإنسان» considered as a genus, so it is made plural with regard to the meaning; «سيئة»: the fāʿil of «تصبهم»; «بما»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تصبهم﴾; «ما»: relative; the clause ﴿قدمت أيديهم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position, and the returning pronoun is omitted, i.e. «قدمته» (which they sent forth); the fāʾ is connective, or [introduces] the cause of an implied apodosis, the implied form being «وإن تصبهم سيئة نسوا النعمة فورًا» (and if an evil befalls them, they forget the blessing at once); «إن»: an abrogating particle; «الإنسان»: the noun of «إن»; «كفور»: the khabar of «إن»; the clause ﴿إن الإنسان كفور﴾ is jussive [in position] as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), or a causal explanation of the implied apodosis.

muyesser-irab:49-49.t:
﴿لله ملك السماوات والأرض يخلق ما يشاء﴾: «لله»: a preposition and a genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); «مُلك»: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); «السماوات»: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «الأرض»: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «السماوات»; the clause ﴿يخلق﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial); «ما»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿يخلق﴾; the clause ﴿يشاء﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿يهب لمن يشاء إناثا ويهب لمن يشاء الذكور﴾: «يهب»: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو), referring back to Allah the Exalted; «لمن»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يهب﴾; the clause ﴿يشاء﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position; «إناثًا»: mafʿūl bihi; ﴿يهب لمن يشاء الذكور﴾ is conjoined to the preceding clause; the clause ﴿يهب لمن يشاء﴾ is a badal (substitute) of the clause ﴿يخلق ما يشاء﴾, a badal of the detailed for the summary.

muyesser-irab:50-50.t:
﴿أو يزوجهم ذكرانا وإناثا ويجعل من يشاء عقيما﴾: «أو»: a conjunction; «يزوجهم»: an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) referring back to Him, glory be to Him, and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «ذكرانًا وإناثًا»: the second mafʿūl bihi of «يزوجهم», on the basis that it includes the sense of making [something into something] (taṣyīr), i.e. He makes his children males and females, as shown by what follows it; or they are parsed as two ḥāls (circumstantials); «يجعل من يشاء عقيمًا»: conjoined to what preceded; «عقيمًا»: necessarily a second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿إنه عليم قدير﴾: «إن»: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the hāʾ: the noun of «إن»; «عليم قدير»: two khabars (predicates) of «إن».

muyesser-irab:51-51.t:
﴿وما كان لبشر أن يكلمه الله إلا وحيا أو من وراء حجاب أو يرسل رسولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, or resumptive; «ما»: negative; «كان»: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; «لبشر»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of «كان»; «أن»: maṣdariyya, making accusative; «يكلمه»: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by ﴿أن﴾; the hāʾ: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «الله»: the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿يكلمه﴾, in the position of a nominative as the noun of «كان» [Translator's note: so in the text; it is presumably the interpreted maṣdar «أن يكلمه الله» that is in the position of the noun of «كان», «الله» being simply the fāʿil]; «إلا»: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); «وحيًا»: a maṣdar (verbal noun) occurring in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) because it is an attribute of the maṣdar, the implied form being «إلا كلامًا وحيًا» (except speech by revelation), i.e. revealed; the clause ﴿وما كان لبشر...﴾ is conjoined, or resumptive with no grammatical position; «أو»: a conjunction; «من وراء»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted verb conjoined to «يوحي» [Translator's note: so in the text, though no «يوحي» precedes in the verse; «وحيًا» is evidently meant], i.e. «يكلمه» (He speaks to him); «حجاب»: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «أو»: a conjunction; «يرسل»: an imperfect verb, accusative by an «أن» concealed after ﴿أو﴾, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); «رسولا»: mafʿūl bihi, accusative; the interpreted maṣdar from the concealed «أن» and ﴿يرسل﴾ is conjoined to the maṣdar ﴿وحيا﴾, accusative.
﴿فيوحي بإذنه ما يشاء إنه علي حكيم﴾: «فيوحي» is conjoined to «يرسل»; «بإذنه»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يوحي﴾; «ما»: mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿يشاء﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position; «إن»: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is the noun of «إن»; «علي حكيم»: two khabars of «إن»; the clause ﴿إنه علي حكيم﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:52-52.t:
﴿وكذلك أوحينا إليك روحا من أمرنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «كذلك»: the kāf is a noun in the sense of «مثل» (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), a ṣifa (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar of ﴿أوحينا﴾, placed before its governor, the implied form being «مثل ذلك الإيحاء الفصل أوحينا إليك» (like that decisive revelation We revealed to you); ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; «أوحينا»: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); «إليك»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أوحينا﴾; «روحًا»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «من أمرنا»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿روحًا﴾; and it has been said: a ḥāl (circumstantial), and «من» is partitive, i.e. this spirit — which is the Quran — being part of what We reveal to you.
﴿ما كنت تدري ما الكتاب ولا الإيمان﴾: the clause is a ḥāl of the kāf in «إليك»; «ما»: negative; «كنت»: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is a pronoun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), the noun of «كان»; «تدري»: an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); «ما»: interrogative, suspending ﴿تدري﴾ from operation, in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); «الكتاب»: khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿ما الكتاب﴾ is in the position of an accusative, standing in place of the two objects of ﴿تدري﴾; «لا الإيمان»: conjoined to «الكتاب».
﴿ولكن جعلناه نورا نهدي به من نشاء من عبادنا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) or a conjunction; «لكن»: a particle of rectification (istidrāk); «جعلناه»: a verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; «نورًا»: a second mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿نهدي به﴾ is a ṣifa of ﴿نورًا﴾; «مَن»: mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿نشاء﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position; «من عبادنا»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of ﴿مَن﴾.
﴿وإنك لتهدي إلى صراط مستقيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «إن»: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the kāf is the noun of «إن»; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause ﴿تهدي﴾ is the khabar, and the object of «تهدي» is omitted, i.e. you guide every legally responsible (mukallaf) person; «إلى صراط»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تهدي﴾; «مستقيم»: a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:53-53.t:
﴿صراط الله الذي له ما في السماوات وما في الأرض﴾: «صراط»: a badal (substitute) of the preceding ﴿صراط﴾; «الله»: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «الذي»: a naʿt (adjective) of «الله»; «له»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); «ما»: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); «في السماوات»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause), and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. ﴿ما في الأرض﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ما في السماوات﴾.
﴿ألا إلى الله تصير الأمور﴾: «ألا»: a particle of alerting (tanbīh); «إلى الله»: a preposition and a genitive noun, attached to ﴿تصير﴾; «الأمور»: fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:1-1.t: ﴿حم﴾: the discussion of the disjointed letters (al-ḥurūf al-muqaṭṭaʿa) has preceded at the beginning of Surat al-Baqara.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t: ﴿عسق﴾: the discussion of the disjointed letters (al-ḥurūf al-muqaṭṭaʿa) has preceded at the beginning of Surat al-Baqara.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t: ﴿كذلك يوحي إليك وإلى الذين من قبلك الله العزيز الحكيم﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa in the position of accusative as naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being: "a revelation like that revelation He reveals to you" (إيحاءً مثلَ ذلك الإيحاء يوحي إليك); and ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address. ويوحي: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). وإليك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿يوحي﴾. و﴿إلى الذين﴾: conjoined to إليك. و﴿من قبلك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿الذين﴾; the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. والله: fāʿil (agent). والعزيز الحكيم: two naʿts of الله.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿له ما في السماوات وما في الأرض﴾: له: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). وما: delayed mubtadaʾ (subject). وفي السماوات: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. و﴿ما في الأرض﴾: conjoined.
﴿وهو العلي العظيم﴾: هو: mubtadaʾ. والعلي العظيم: two khabars of هو.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿تكاد السماوات يتفطرن من فوقهن﴾: تكاد: an imperfect verb, one of the verbs of approximation (afʿāl al-muqāraba). والسماوات: its noun; the clause ﴿يتفطرن﴾ is its khabar (predicate). ومن فوقهن: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿يتفطرن﴾.
﴿والملائكة يسبحون بحمد ربهم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. والملائكة: mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يسبحون﴾ is in the position of nominative as khabar. وبحمد: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يسبحون﴾. وربهم: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ويستغفرون لمن في الأرض ألا إن الله هو الغفور الرحيم﴾: يستغفرون: conjoined to يسبحون. ولمن: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يستغفرون﴾. وفي الأرض: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. وألا: a particle of drawing attention (tanbīh). وإن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty: the noun of إن. وهو: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). والغفور الرحيم: two khabars of إن.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t: ﴿والذين اتخذوا من دونه أولياء الله حفيظ عليهم وما أنت عليهم بوكيل﴾: الذين: mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause ﴿اتخذوا﴾, made of the verb and its fāʿil (agent), is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ومن دونه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the hāʾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). وأولياء: the first object of اتخذوا. The Name of Majesty: mubtadaʾ. وحفيظ: khabar (predicate). وعليهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿حفيظ﴾. The clause ﴿الله حفيظ عليهم﴾ is in the position of nominative as khabar of الذين. The wāw is a conjunction. وما: the Ḥijāzī negative, which operates like ليس. وأنت: the noun of ما. وعليهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿وكيل﴾. و﴿بوكيل﴾: the bāʾ is a redundant (ṣila) preposition, and ﴿وكيل﴾ is the khabar of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and genitive in form by the bāʾ.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿وكذلك أوحينا إليك قرآنا عربيا لتنذر أم القرى ومن حولها﴾: the wāw is resumptive. ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa in the position of accusative as naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "like that revelation We revealed" (مثل ذلك الإيحاء أوحينا); and ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address. وأوحينا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent). وإليك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿أوحينا﴾. وقرآنًا: the object of أوحينا. وعربيًّا: naʿt. The clause ﴿وكذلك أوحينا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The lām is for giving the reason (taʿlīl). وتنذر: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أوحينا﴾. وأم القرى: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of تنذر. ومن: conjoined to أم القرى. وحولها: an adverb attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾; the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿وتنذر يوم الجمع لا ريب فيه فريق في الجنة وفريق في السعير﴾: تنذر: conjoined to لتنذر. ويوم الجمع: second mafʿūl bihi of تنذر; the first object is omitted, i.e. "and that you may warn the people of the Day of Gathering" (وتنذر الناس يوم الجمع), meaning its punishment. So the first object was omitted from the second warning, just as the second object was omitted from the first warning, its implied form being: the punishment (العذاب). ولا: the lā of generic negation. وريب: its noun. وفيه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). The clause is ḥāl (circumstantial) of يوم الجمع, or resumptive with no grammatical position. وفريق: mubtadaʾ (subject). وفي الجنة: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar; beginning with it is permitted by the division into kinds and detailing. و﴿فريق في السعير﴾: conjoined to what preceded. Or فريق is khabar of an implied mubtadaʾ, i.e. "those gathered" (المجموعون).

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿ولو شاء الله لجعلهم أمة واحدة﴾: the wāw is resumptive. ولو: conditional. وشاء الله: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). The lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb) of لو. The clause ﴿جعلهم﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; the hāʾ is first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). وأمة: second mafʿūl bihi. وواحدة: naʿt (adjective) of أمة, i.e. upon one religion. The clause ﴿ولو شاء الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولكن يدخل من يشاء في رحمته والظالمون ما لهم من ولي ولا نصير﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ولكن: a particle of rectification (istidrāk). ويدخل: an imperfect verb; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو". ومَن: mafʿūl bihi. The clause ﴿يشاء﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position, and the returning pronoun is omitted. وفي رحمته: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿يدخل﴾. والظالمون: mubtadaʾ (subject). وما: negative. ولهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ومن: a redundant (ṣila) preposition. وولي: genitive in form and nominative in position as delayed mubtadaʾ. ولا نصير: conjoined to ﴿من ولي﴾. The clause ﴿ما لهم ...﴾ is the khabar of ﴿الظالمون﴾.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿أم اتخذوا من دونه أولياء﴾: أم: a conjunction; it is the disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) أم, meaning "rather" (بل) plus the interrogative hamza, and the interrogative is disapproving. واتخذوا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent). ومن دونه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). وأولياء: the first object of اتخذوا.
﴿فالله هو الولي وهو يحي الموتى وهو على كل شيء قدير﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition), or a conjunction. والله: mubtadaʾ (subject). وهو: a second mubtadaʾ, or a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position. والولي: the khabar (predicate) of هو, and the clause is the khabar of ﴿الله﴾. وهو: mubtadaʾ. و﴿يحيي الموتى﴾: khabar. و﴿هو على كل شيء قدير﴾: also conjoined to what preceded.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿وما اختلفتم فيه من شيء فحكمه إلى الله﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. وما: conditional, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); or a relative noun. واختلفتم: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is fāʿil (agent). وفيه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿اختلفتم﴾. ومن شيء: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in ﴿فيه﴾, or a tamyīz (specification) of it. The fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). وحكمه: mubtadaʾ. وإلى الله: a preposition and a genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate), i.e. "returned and referred to Allah" (مردود وراجع إلى الله).
﴿ذلكم الله ربي عليه توكلت وإليه أنيب﴾: ذلكم: mubtadaʾ. والله: khabar, or badal (substitute) of ذلكم. وربي: a second khabar. وعليه: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿توكلت﴾. وتوكلت: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause ﴿عليه توكلت﴾ is a third khabar. وإليه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أنيب﴾. وأنيب: an imperfect verb; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنا". The clause ﴿وإليه أنيب﴾ is a fourth khabar.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿فاطر السماوات والأرض﴾: a fifth khabar (predicate), or khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هو". والسماوات: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). والأرض: maʿṭūf (conjoined).
﴿جعل لكم من أنفسكم﴾: the clause is a sixth khabar. وجعل: a past verb; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو". ولكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) if it has the meaning of "making into" (taṣyīr), and attached to ﴿جعل﴾ if it has the meaning of "creating". ومن أنفسكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of أزواجا.
﴿أزواجا ومن الأنعام أزواجا يذرؤكم فيه﴾: أزواجًا: the first object of جعل. ومن الأنعام أزواجًا: conjoined to the preceding. The clause ﴿يذرؤكم﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أزواجًا﴾. وفيه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يذرؤكم﴾; the pronoun refers to the making or the arranging.
﴿ليس كمثله شيء وهو السميع البصير﴾: a seventh khabar. وليس: a deficient past verb. والكاف: redundant (ṣila). ومثله: genitive in form and accusative in position, because it is the khabar of ليس. وشيء: its noun. وهو: mubtadaʾ. والسميع البصير: two khabars of ﴿هو﴾.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿له مقاليد السماوات والأرض﴾: له: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ومقاليد: delayed mubtadaʾ (subject). والسماوات: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). والأرض: maʿṭūf (conjoined). The clause is an eighth khabar.
﴿يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء ويقدر﴾: the clause ﴿يبسط الرزق﴾ is a ninth khabar. ويبسط: an imperfect verb; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو". والرزق: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ولمن: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يبسط﴾. The clause ﴿يشاء﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ويقدر: conjoined to ﴿يشاء﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source; in meaning ويقدر pairs with يبسط].
﴿إنه بكل شيء عليم﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and the hāʾ is the noun of إن. وعليم: the khabar of إن. وبكل: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿عليم﴾. وشيء: muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿شرع لكم من الدين ما وصى به نوحا والذي أوحينا إليك﴾: a tenth khabar (predicate), or a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. وشرع: a past verb; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو". ولكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿شرع﴾. ومن الدين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ما. وما: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ﴿وصى﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. وبه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿وصى﴾. ونوحًا: mafʿūl bihi. والذي: conjoined to ما. The clause ﴿أوحينا﴾ is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. وإليك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أوحينا﴾.
﴿وما وصينا به إبراهيم وموسى وعيسى﴾: also conjoined to what preceded.
﴿أن أقيموا الدين ولا تتفرقوا فيه﴾: ﴿أن﴾: explicative (tafsīriyya), and the clause after it is explicative, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿أن﴾ is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with what follows it as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being ﴿هو﴾; or the interpreted maṣdar is an accusative badal (substitute) of the relative noun, namely ﴿ما﴾, or a genitive badal of ﴿الدين﴾; and the clause ﴿أقيموا الدين﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya ﴿أن﴾, with no grammatical position. ﴿أقيموا الدين﴾: an imperative verb, the wāw is fāʿil, and الدين is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is prohibitive. وتتفرقوا: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا. وفيه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تتفرقوا﴾.
﴿كبر على المشركين ما تدعوهم إليه الله يجتبي إليه من يشاء ويهدي إليه من ينيب﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. وكبر: a past verb. وعلى المشركين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿كبر﴾. وما: fāʿil. The clause ﴿تدعوهم﴾ is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. وإليه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تدعوهم﴾. والله: mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿يجتبي﴾ is khabar. وإليه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يجتبي﴾. ومَن: mafʿūl bihi. The clause ﴿يشاء﴾ is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. ويهدي: conjoined to يجتبي. وإليه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يهدي﴾. ومَن: mafʿūl bihi. The clause ﴿ينيب﴾ is the ṣila, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿وما تفرقوا إلا من بعد ما جاءهم العلم بغيا بينهم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. وما: negative. وتفرقوا: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). وإلا: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ومن بعد: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to تفرقوا; the exception is from the most general of states, so it is also attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). وما: maṣdariyya, interpreted together with what falls within its scope as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). و﴿جاءهم العلم﴾: a past verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a fāʿil. وبغيًا: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); or a maṣdar interpreted as a derived adjective, and so accusative as ḥāl, i.e. "transgressing" (باغين). و﴿بينهم﴾: بين is an adverb attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿بغيًا﴾; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the mīm is the sign of the plural.
﴿ولولا كلمة سبقت من ربك إلى أجل مسمى لقضي بينهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ولولا: a particle of non-occurrence due to occurrence (imtināʿ li-wujūd). وكلمة: mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted; the clause ﴿سبقت﴾ is a naʿt of كلمة. و﴿من ربك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿سبقت﴾. و﴿إلى أجل﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿سبقت﴾. ومسمى: naʿt of أجل. The lām occurs in the answer of لولا. وقضي: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is the maṣdar understood from قضي, i.e. the judging (القضاء). و﴿بينهم﴾: بين is an adverb attached to ﴿قضي﴾; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the mīm is the sign of the plural. The clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿وإن الذين أورثوا الكتاب من بعدهم لفي شك منه مريب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, or circumstantial (ḥāliyya), built [Translator's note: the source has «مبنية», probably for «مبيِّنة», "explaining"] for the manner of the polytheists' disbelief in the Quran. وإن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters). والذين: the noun of إن. The clause ﴿أورثوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. وأورثوا: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil. والكتاب: second mafʿūl bihi. The lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). و﴿في شك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of إن. ومنه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt of شك. ومريب: a second naʿt.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿فلذلك فادع واستقم كما أمرت﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition). ولذلك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿ادع﴾. The second fāʾ is an emphasis of the first fāʾ, and the lām has the meaning of إلى (to). واستقم: conjoined to ادع. و﴿كما﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa in the position of accusative as naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being: "be upright with an uprightness like that which you were commanded" (استقم استقامةً مثلَ الذي أُمرت به), i.e. an uprightness in accordance with what you were commanded, fulfilling it. و﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). وأمرت: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the tāʾ is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The clause ﴿أمرت﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولا تتبع أهواءهم وقل آمنت بما أنزل الله من كتاب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is prohibitive. وتتبع: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنت". وأهواءهم: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). وقل: an imperative verb; its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "أنت". The clause ﴿آمنت﴾ is the quoted speech. وبما: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿آمنت﴾. The clause ﴿أنزل الله﴾ is the ṣila, with no grammatical position, and the returning pronoun is omitted, i.e. أنزله الله. ومن كتاب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وأمرت لأعدل بينكم﴾: ﴿وأمرت﴾: conjoined to آمنت. وأمرت: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named, and the tāʾ is nāʾib fāʿil. و﴿لأعدل﴾: the lām is the lām of giving the reason (taʿlīl), and أعدل is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām; the interpreted maṣdar from the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the imperfect verb is genitive by the lām, and the lām with its genitive noun is attached to ﴿أُمرت﴾, the implied form being: "and I was commanded what I was commanded so that I may be just among you" (وأُمرت بما أمرت به لأعدل بينكم). وبينكم: an adverb attached to أعدل.
﴿الله ربنا وربكم لنا أعمالنا ولكم أعمالكم﴾: the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject). وربنا: its khabar (predicate). وربكم: conjoined to ربنا. ولنا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. وأعمالنا: delayed mubtadaʾ. ولكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. وأعمالكم: delayed mubtadaʾ.
﴿لا حجة بيننا وبينكم الله يجمع بيننا وإليه المصير﴾: لا: the lā of generic negation. وحجة: the noun of لا, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa. وبيننا: an adverb attached to an omitted khabar. The Name of Majesty: mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿يجمع﴾ is khabar. وبيننا: an adverb attached to ﴿يجمع﴾, i.e. on the Day of Resurrection. وإليه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. والمصير: delayed mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿والذين يحاجون في الله من بعد ما استجيب له حجتهم داحضة عند ربهم﴾: الذين: mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause ﴿يحاجون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. و﴿في الله﴾: a preposition and a genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿يحاجون﴾; it is with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "concerning the religion of Allah" (في دين الله). و﴿من بعد﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). وما: maṣdariyya. واستجيب: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive). وله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of استجيب; or a preposition and its genitive noun attached to it, with the nāʾib fāʿil latent (mustatir). The interpreted maṣdar from ﴿ما استجيب﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). وحجتهم: mubtadaʾ. وداحضة: the khabar (predicate) of حجتهم. The clause ﴿حجتهم داحضة﴾ is the khabar of the first mubtadaʾ ﴿الذين﴾. وعند: an adverb attached to داحضة. وربهم: muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وعليهم غضب ولهم عذاب شديد﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. وعليهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. وغضب: delayed mubtadaʾ. ولهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. وعذاب: delayed mubtadaʾ. وشديد: naʿt (adjective) of عذاب.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿الله الذي أنزل الكتاب بالحق والميزان﴾: الله: mubtadaʾ (subject). والذي: its khabar (predicate). The clause ﴿أنزل الكتاب﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. وبالحق: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿أنزل﴾, or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). والميزان: conjoined to الحق [Translator's note: so in the source; it is more commonly taken as conjoined to الكتاب].
﴿وما يدريك لعل الساعة قريب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. وما: an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿يدريك﴾ is khabar. ولعل: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters). والساعة: the noun of لعل. وقريب: its khabar. The clause ﴿لعل الساعة قريب﴾ is in the position of accusative, standing in place of the second and third objects of the verb ﴿يدريك﴾. A muḍāf must be implied, i.e. "perhaps the coming of the Hour is near" (لعل مجيء الساعة قريب).

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿يستعجل بها الذين لا يؤمنون بها﴾: يستعجل: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). وبها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿يستعجل﴾. والذين: fāʿil (agent). The clause ﴿لا يؤمنون بها﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position.
﴿والذين آمنوا مشفقون منها ويعلمون أنها الحق﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. والذين: mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. ومشفقون: khabar (predicate). ومنها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مشفقون﴾. The wāw is a conjunction. ويعلمون: an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil. أن with what falls within its scope stands in place of the two objects of يعلمون.
﴿ألا إن الذين يمارون في الساعة لفي ضلال بعيد﴾: ألا: a particle of drawing attention (tanbīh). وإن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters). والذين: the noun of إن. The clause ﴿يمارون﴾ is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. وفي الساعة: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يمارون﴾. The lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). و﴿في ضلال﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of إن. وبعيد: naʿt (adjective) of ضلال.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t: ﴿الله لطيف بعباده يرزق من يشاء وهو القوي العزيز﴾: الله: mubtadaʾ (subject). ولطيف: khabar (predicate). وبعباده: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿لطيف﴾. The clause ﴿يرزق﴾ is a second khabar. ومَن: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ﴿يشاء﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. The wāw is a conjunction. وهو: mubtadaʾ. والقوي: khabar. والعزيز: a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿من كان يريد حرث الآخرة نزد له في حرثه﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. ومَن: a conditional noun causing the jussive, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). وكان: a deficient past verb; its noun refers back to مَن; the clause ﴿يريد﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of كان. و﴿حرث الآخرة﴾: the object of يريد. ونزد: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). وله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿نزد﴾. و﴿في حرثه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to ﴿نزد﴾.
﴿ومن كان يريد حرث الدنيا نؤته منها﴾: conjoined to the preceding clause. ومَن: a conditional noun causing the jussive, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. وكان: a deficient past verb; its noun is latent (mustatir), referring back to مَن; the clause ﴿يريد﴾ is the khabar of كان. و﴿حرث الدنيا﴾: the object of يريد. ونؤته: the apodosis. ومنها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نؤته﴾.
﴿وما له في الآخرة من نصيب﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) or a conjunction. و﴿ما﴾: negative. وله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. و﴿في الآخرة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ومن: a redundant (ṣila) preposition. ونصيب: delayed mubtadaʾ, or the noun of ما.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿أم لهم شركاء شرعوا لهم من الدين ما لم يأذن به الله﴾: أم: a conjunction; it is the disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) أم, meaning "rather" (بل) plus the interrogative hamza, i.e. "Rather, do they have partners?" (بل ألهم شركاء); the hamza is for reproach and rebuke. ولهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). وشركاء: delayed mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause ﴿شرعوا﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of شركاء. ولهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to شرعوا. و﴿من الدين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). وما: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ﴿لم يأذن﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. وبه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يأذن. والله: fāʿil (agent).
﴿ولولا كلمة الفصل لقضي بينهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ولولا: a particle of non-occurrence due to occurrence (imtināʿ li-wujūd). و﴿كلمة الفصل﴾: mubtadaʾ, and the khabar is omitted. The lām occurs in the answer of لولا. The clause ﴿قضي بينهم﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿وإن الظالمين لهم عذاب أليم﴾: the wāw is resumptive. وإن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters). والظالمين: the noun of إن. ولهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. وعذاب: delayed mubtadaʾ. وأليم: naʿt. The clause ﴿لهم عذاب أليم﴾ is the khabar of إن, and the clause ﴿وإن الظالمين...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿ترى الظالمين مشفقين مما كسبوا وهو واقع بهم﴾: ترى: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنت". والظالمين: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ومشفقين: ḥāl (circumstantial), because the seeing is visual. ومما: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿مشفقين﴾. The clause ﴿كسبوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). وهو: mubtadaʾ (subject). وواقع: khabar (predicate). و﴿بهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿واقع﴾. The clause ﴿وهو واقع بهم﴾ is a second ḥāl; the pronoun refers to the earning or to the fearing.
﴿والذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات في روضات الجنات﴾: الذين: mubtadaʾ. The clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. وعملوا: conjoined to آمنوا. والصالحات: mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra. The clause ﴿وعملوا الصالحات﴾ has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause. و﴿في روضات﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of الذين. والجنات: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿لهم ما يشاءون عند ربهم﴾: لهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. وما: delayed mubtadaʾ. The clause ﴿يشاءون﴾ is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. وعند: an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl of the returning pronoun of ﴿ما﴾, or of the wāw of ﴿يشاءون﴾.
﴿ذلك هو الفضل الكبير﴾: ذلك: mubtadaʾ. وهو: a second mubtadaʾ, or a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position. والفضل: the khabar of the second; ﴿هو الفضل﴾ is the khabar of ﴿ذلك﴾. والكبير: naʿt (adjective).
